proven: All four historical Point_data anchor root IDs occur among the endpoints of the 649 canonical synapse-coordinate rows.
The 649-row synapse artifact contains additional partner roots; it is therefore a connectivity/synapse-coordinate case around the four anchors, not a four-root-only table.
Point_data is per-neuron morphology metrics, while synapses.csv is per-synapse coordinate data; there is no row-level primary key joining a synapse row to a Point_data morphology row.
not_proven: The 649 synapse rows do not prove which historical morphology materialization or manual dendrite correction produced Point_data.
Shared root IDs alone do not prove that the synapse-coordinate snapshot and Point_data were generated in the same software run or at the same internal data revision.
